mapper.sql: select record_id, record_code, qc_type, workorder_id, workorder_code, task_id, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, supplier_id, supplier_name, inspect_quantity, checked_quantity, qualified_quantity, defective_quantity, result, status, standard_id, defect_desc, defect_reason, handle_method, inspect_time, inspector_id, inspector_name, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qc_record
mapper.insert: insert into qc_record ( record_code, qc_type, workorder_id, workorder_code, task_id, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, supplier_id, supplier_name, inspect_quantity, status, standard_id, inspector_id, inspector_name, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{recordCode}, #{qcType}, #{workorderId}, #{workorderCode}, #{taskId}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{inspectQuantity}, 'PENDING', #{standardId}, #{inspectorId}, #{inspectorName}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update qc_record set result = #{result}, qualified_quantity = #{qualifiedQty}, defective_quantity = #{defectiveQty}, checked_quantity = #{qualifiedQty} + #{defectiveQty}, status = 'COMPLETED', update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select:
select w.workorder_id as workorderId, w.workorder_code as workorderCode, w.item_id as itemId, w.item_code as itemCode, w.item_name as itemName, w.specification as specification, w.quantity as planQuantity, w.supplier_id as supplierId, w.supplier_name as supplierName, t.task_id as taskId, t.process_name as processName from pro_workorder w left join pro_task t on w.workorder_id = t.workorder_id where (w.workorder_code = #{barcode} or w.item_code = #{barcode})
and w.status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
and t.status = 'PROCESSING'
and w.status = 'COMPLETED'
limit 1

select r.record_id as recordId, r.record_code as recordCode, r.qc_type as qcType, r.workorder_code as workorderCode, r.item_name as itemName, r.specification as specification, r.inspect_quantity as inspectQuantity, r.status, r.result, r.inspector_name as inspectorName, timestampdiff(hour, r.create_time, now()) as waitHours from qc_record r where r.status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
and r.qc_type = #{qcType}
and (r.inspector_id = #{inspectorId} or r.inspector_id is null)
order by r.status = 'PROCESSING' desc, r.create_time asc

select r.record_id as recordId, r.record_code as recordCode, r.qc_type as qcType, r.workorder_code as workorderCode, r.item_name as itemName, r.specification as specification, r.inspect_quantity as inspectQuantity, r.checked_quantity as checkedQuantity, r.qualified_quantity as qualifiedQuantity, r.defective_quantity as defectiveQuantity, r.status, r.result, r.inspect_time as inspectTime from qc_record r where r.inspector_id = #{inspectorId} order by r.inspect_time desc limit 50
